auto.name: Auto Rifle
auto.title: Sunforge Litany
auto.lore: Built from a Sarketh pattern taken off the dead. The cell hums a note just under hearing while it fires.

pulse.name: Pulse Rifle
pulse.title: Ninefold Choir
pulse.lore: Nine bolts to a breath, three to a burst. The Institute's engineers never agreed on why it keeps that rhythm.

scout.name: Scout Rifle
scout.title: Farsight Herald
scout.lore: A patient gun for long streets. It finds the shape of a target before the eye does.

handcannon.name: Hand Cannon
handcannon.title: The Undertaker
handcannon.lore: One heavy bolt at a time, and every one of them is meant to be the last.

shotgun.name: Shotgun
shotgun.title: Gravedigger’s Hymn
shotgun.lore: A wall of light at arm's length. Its intake breathes in after every shot like something alive.

sniper.name: Sniper Rifle
sniper.title: Pale Horizon
sniper.lore: From across the drained canal it puts a single point of light exactly where you decide.

smg.name: Submachine Gun
smg.title: Kestrel-X9
smg.lore: Light, fast and hungry: made for the stairwells and corridors of the Stacks.

sidearm.name: Sidearm
sidearm.title: Helios
sidearm.lore: A small sun in the hand. Every runner out of Nexus Prime carries one.

energy.name: Light Lance
energy.title: Eclipse
energy.lore: A lance of gathered light that holds its charge until the moment is right.

hmg.name: Heavy Machine Gun
hmg.title: Atlas
hmg.lore: It turns a street into a wall. Hold the trigger and let the barrels sing.

rocket.name: Rocket Launcher
rocket.title: Starfall Engine
rocket.lore: Slow, bright and final. Whatever it reaches stops being cover.

rifle.name: Assault Rifle
rifle.title: Old Winter
rifle.lore: Honest steel in an old pattern. It was here before the ships came, and it will be here after.

carbine.name: Carbine
carbine.title: Dust Saint
carbine.lore: Short and light, put together from what the workshops of Nexus Prime still had on their shelves.

dmr.name: Battle Rifle
dmr.title: Hearthfire
dmr.lore: Walnut and steel, three rounds to a pull. Somebody's grandfather kept it oiled for this.

ksmg.name: Compact SMG
ksmg.title: Alley Cat
ksmg.lore: It fits under a coat and empties in a heartbeat. Made for close streets and closer rooms.

bolt.name: Bolt-Action Rifle
bolt.title: Long Silence
bolt.lore: One round, one breath, one name crossed off. The quietest gun in the city.

pistol.name: Service Pistol
pistol.title: Gentleman’s Promise
pistol.lore: It always fires, and it always comes home. That was the promise.

revolver.name: Revolver
revolver.title: Six Mercies
revolver.lore: Six chambers, six mercies. Load slowly, and remember who you are.

pump.name: Pump Shotgun
pump.title: Porch Light
pump.lore: A porch light against the dark: loud, close, and impossible to ignore.

spitter.name: Spitter
spitter.title: The Hungering Maw
spitter.lore: Grown, not made. It feeds on what you give it and spits back acid.

bile.name: Bile Cannon
bile.title: Mother of Rot
bile.lore: A living cannon that ripens its shots inside its own body. Do not ask what it eats.

brood.name: Brood Launcher
brood.title: The Gravid Bloom
brood.lore: It lays its rounds. They hatch where they land.

vr_rifle.name: Void Requiem Assault Rifle
vr_rifle.title: Last Rite
vr_rifle.lore: Silver and violet, made by a people no human has met. Every shot rings like a struck bell.

vr_sniper.name: Void Requiem Sniper Rifle
vr_sniper.title: Vigil's End
vr_sniper.lore: It keeps the last watch. What it sees through its glass does not see the morning.

vr_smg.name: Void Requiem Submachine Gun
vr_smg.title: Threnody
vr_smg.lore: A hurried lament: many notes, every one of them grief.

vr_shotgun.name: Void Requiem Shotgun
vr_shotgun.title: Toll of Ruin
vr_shotgun.lore: A single toll, as wide as a doorway.

vr_lmg.name: Void Requiem Light Machine Gun
vr_lmg.title: Last Procession
vr_lmg.lore: A procession of light that does not stop for the fallen.

vr_handcannon.name: Void Requiem Hand Cannon
vr_handcannon.title: Final Verse
vr_handcannon.lore: The last line of a long poem, spoken once.

vr_pistol.name: Void Requiem Pistol
vr_pistol.title: Ashen Psalm
vr_pistol.lore: A small prayer said over ash.

vr_fusion.name: Void Requiem Fusion Rifle
vr_fusion.title: Eulogy
vr_fusion.lore: It gathers its breath before it speaks, and what it says is final.

vr_rocket.name: Void Requiem Rocket Launcher
vr_rocket.title: Funeral Bell
vr_rocket.lore: When it rings, the whole street falls silent.

skr_rifle.name: Veyr Rifle
skr_rifle.title: Ember Oath
skr_rifle.lore: A Sarketh Veteran's rifle. Its crystal condenses slugs out of its own heat, and its oath passes to whoever holds it.

skr_rifle_v2.name: Veyr Rifle II
skr_rifle_v2.title: Ember Oath II
skr_rifle_v2.lore: Ember Oath in mirror steel over woven fire: the rifle the Veterans salute.

skr_sniper.name: Veyr Lance
skr_sniper.title: Pale Verdict
skr_sniper.lore: The Lance passes its verdict through armour, through cover, and through the one behind.

skr_cannon.name: Veyr Breaker
skr_cannon.title: Ashen Gate
skr_cannon.lore: A Bearer's launcher. Its drum condenses slugs heavy enough to open a wall.

skr_shotgun.name: Veyr Scatter
skr_shotgun.title: Shard Choir
skr_shotgun.lore: A spray of amber shards, each one singing its own note as it goes.

skr_pistol.name: Veyr Sidearm
skr_pistol.title: Small Flame
skr_pistol.lore: Every Sarketh officer keeps a small flame on the belt.

skr_handcannon.name: Veyr Judge
skr_handcannon.title: Heavy Ember
skr_handcannon.lore: A heavy slug, condensed slowly and thrown hard. The Speakers carry it to end arguments.

palettes._rule: the owner, 2026-11-15: every gun of a set has the same colour palette and fires the same colour. A gun's palette is its set's ("set"), else its class's family (energy: light, kinetic, horror); no archetype has a colour of its own

explosive.name: Shrapnel Rounds
explosive.desc: Precision hits deal bonus splash damage.

frenzy.name: Overclock
frenzy.desc: Fire rate +20% while shields are down.

spoils.name: Spoils
spoils.desc: A kill puts a fifth of the magazine back from the reserve.

second_skin.name: Second Skin
second_skin.desc: A kill starts your shield refilling at once.

hot_hands.name: Hot Hands
hot_hands.desc: A reload begun within 3 s of a kill is 40% faster.

cold_bore.name: Cold Bore
cold_bore.desc: The first shot after 2 s of quiet hits 25% harder and flies true.

last_third.name: Last Third
last_third.desc: The last third of the magazine hits 15% harder.

point_shooter.name: Point Shooter
point_shooter.desc: Half the spread from the hip.

slide_feed.name: Slide Feed
slide_feed.desc: Going into a slide fills the magazine from the reserve.

tracer_core.name: Tracer Core
tracer_core.desc: Precision hits set the target burning.

match_grade.name: Match Grade
match_grade.desc: Rounds lose no damage with distance.

baffled_muzzle.name: Baffled Muzzle
baffled_muzzle.desc: Shots are heard a third as far.

clinging_acid.name: Clinging Acid
clinging_acid.desc: What it hits is slowed for 1.5 s.

difficulty.note: scales on what the creatures and their brain already have (1 = as written): a harder level makes them better, not just tougher. notice / reaction / aimError / burst / burstPause / patience / coverHold / flankShare (0-1) / abilityCooldown / health / damage

attributes.note: A character's six attributes: points that worn armour gives (USOInventoryComponent::GetAttributePoints), 0 to 'max'; more than 'max' does nothing more. 'rules': what an attribute scales, as the scale it reaches at 'max' points (1 at none, a straight line between): plating = on all damage taken; mending = on the wait before the shield refills ('atMax2': on how fast it refills); stride = on movement speed; ordnance / impact = on the grenade's / the melee's cooldown; focus = on everything that charges the ultimate. 'armour': a piece's points = its armour rating x pointsPerArmour x rarityScale[rarity] x (1 + power x perPower); 'lean' of them go to the attribute its slot leans to ('slotLean'), the rest to two others the copy rolled.

mending.name: Mending
mending.effect: The shield refills sooner and faster

progression.note: Two things kept apart: the character's level (from experience) and each piece of gear's power (from finding better, or from upgrading). 'xp': the experience the next level takes = base + level x perLevel, up to maxLevel. 'powerCap': how far an upgrade may take a piece = base + level x perLevel (a level's worth: gear can go further). 'upgrade': one raises a piece's power by 'step' and costs (credits + power x creditsPerPower) x rarityCost[rarity] credits and (alloy + power x alloyPerPower) x the same in alloy. 'upgrade.goods': a raise also takes the piece's material (its gun class's, or armour's) by rarity, and void crystal for Legendary and Sovereign.

goods._doc: What raising takes beside credits and alloy: a gun's class's material ('gun', by class), an armour piece's ('armour'), 'count' of it by rarity; and 'rareCount' of 'rare' by rarity (Legendary and Sovereign).

bosses.note: A boss is a species (or a level's variant of one) that names one of these tables (ASOEnemy::BossId, a variant's 'boss'): its phases by health ('from' = the share of its health at which the phase begins), the kit it fights with in each, scales on its cooldowns / speed / the damage it takes, the pause between its moves, whether the phase begins behind a shield fed by conduits (destroy them and it reels for 'stagger' seconds), and its weak points (a ball of 'radius' cm at 'offset' forward / right / up of the body from 'bone'; 'scale' on top of a precision hit; 'breakDamage' on it within one phase breaks it: the boss reels for 'breakStagger' seconds and the point is shut until the next phase).

vanguard.name: Vanguard
vanguard.note: working name; the frontline kit: goes in first, takes the hits, breaks a group apart.

passive.name: Close Quarters
passive.note: a kill within closeRange cm gives closeKillShield of shield back at once

bulwark.name: Bulwark
bulwark.note: a creature's kit: the species decides when (ASOBulwark::ThinkCombat), this says what.

veilborn.name: Veilborn
veilborn.note: a creature's kit: the species decides when (ASOVeilborn::ThinkCombat), this says what.

commander.name: Commander
commander.note: a role: put on a species by a level's variant ("kit": "commander"). It calls its squad on; kill it first.

disruptor.name: Disruptor
disruptor.note: a role: caught in its pulse, a player's abilities are out for the duration. Its wind-up is the chance to get clear.

hunter.name: Hunter
hunter.note: a role: an elite that fights the way a player does: a lunge up close, a charge thrown to move its target.

alpha.name: Pack Alpha
alpha.note: a role: the pack's leader. Its howl sends the pack in faster; with it down the pack falters.

colossus.name: Hollow Colossus
colossus.note: the Colossus's first phase. A boss's attacks are abilities: the species decides when (ASOColossus::ThinkCombat, any of those that would land), this says what. windUp is the warning; clipLead is the time into the clip at which the blow lands (the clip is drawn out to the wind-up).

colossus_choir.name: Colossus: the garrison answers
colossus_choir.note: second phase (boss table 'colossus'): the same, a longer barrage, and the ground breaking open under those it fights.

colossus_root.name: Colossus: the core burns
colossus_root.note: third phase: the slam is the Sundering (a heavy attack: nearly twice the reach, a long warning), more marks, sooner.

warden_fury.name: The Gatekeeper: the gate breaks
warden_fury.note: the Warden's second phase (boss table 'warden'): the Bulwark's slam, wider and sooner.

marksman.name: Marksman
marksman.note: a role: a creature given this kit by a variant is a marksman. Its long shot is aimed in the open: a line of light follows the target for the wind-up and locks for the last 0.3 s; the shot goes down the line. 'radius' = it is not used on a target closer than this; 'magnitude' = after this many shots it finds another place.

melee._doc: Hand to hand (the owner, 2026-11-15): the guns on the back, fire = the light chain, aim = the heavy blow. hit = seconds into the body's clip at which it lands; recover = seconds before the next blow; range cm from the eye, angle degrees either side of the aim; force cm/s thrown back, stagger s; lunge cm/s the body steps in. -> SO_IMPORT_ONLY=melee -> /Game/Data/DA_Melee

fists.name: Fists
fists.lore: Your hands, your guard, your rhythm. Nothing to load, nothing to lose.

skr_blade.name: Veyr Edge
skr_blade.lore: Mirror steel round a heart of glass and light. It cuts plate as if it remembered being forged for it.

traits._doc: The trait every gun of a set (or, with no set, its class's family) carries: the armoury's gold node. -> USOWeaponData::TraitName / TraitText

sarketh.name: Condenser
sarketh.text: Never reloads: rounds condense from the reserve once the crystal is cold. Its slugs go through.

void_requiem.name: Requiem
void_requiem.text: Violet bolts that ring like bells; reloads of its own making.

energy.name: Plasma
energy.text: Fires bolts of light that are seen to fly: lead a moving target at range.

kinetic.name: True Flight
kinetic.text: Real rounds with a muzzle speed and drop.

horror.name: Biomass
horror.text: A living weapon: what it fires burns and clings.

families._doc: What kind of gun: the armoury's categories, in this order, each in its slot (0 primary, 1 special, 2 heavy). Every archetype names its own 'family'. -> USOLootTables::Families, USOWeaponData::Family

origins._doc: Who made it: the armoury's second list. An archetype's 'origin' is its set, or by its class: light guns the Institute's, ballistic Nexus Prime's, living ones grown. -> USOLootTables::Origins, USOWeaponData::Origin

origins.name: The Institute
origins.text: Light guns built on Sarketh patterns taken off the dead.

origins.name: Nexus Prime
origins.text: Ballistic steel from the city's own workshops.

origins.name: Sarketh
origins.text: Their own guns: crystal slugs, condensed and never reloaded.

origins.name: Void Requiem
origins.text: Made by a people no human has met.

goods._doc: Everything collected that is not a gun or a piece of armour (the armoury's INVENTORY), in the order shown. kind: material (raises gear: progression.upgrade.goods), consumable (used from the inventory: heal / shield / ultimate = the share of the full amount given back at once), key, relic (a trophy, one of each). stack = the most carried. -> USOLootTables::Goods (SO_IMPORT_ONLY=goods)

goods.name: Amber Condensate
goods.lore: The crystal the Sarketh's guns condense their slugs from, chipped off the fallen. The Institute's light guns burn it in their cells.

goods.name: Machined Parts
goods.lore: Springs, pins and milled steel from the workshops of Nexus Prime, and from every ballistic gun taken apart.

goods.name: Brood Resin
goods.lore: A living gun's sap, set hard. It keeps a slow pulse for days after it is cut.

goods.name: Forged Plate
goods.lore: Shards of the pale shells the Sarketh wear: enamel over forged iron. Good armour can be beaten out of them.

goods.name: Void Crystal
goods.lore: The empire's power, grown and never mined. Nobody on Earth knows how to make it: we only know how to take it.
goods.source: Elites  ·  bosses  ·  reliquaries  ·  dismantled Legendary guns

goods.name: Field Stim
goods.lore: An Institute auto-injector: a clotting agent and a fast stimulant. It stings, and then it doesn't.
goods.use: Gives back 60 % of your health at once.

goods.name: Shield Cell
goods.lore: A charged cell keyed to your suit's emitters. Snap it in two and the shield is back.

goods.name: Overcharge
goods.lore: A splinter of void crystal sealed in glass. Crushed in the palm, it pours into the suit's reserve.

goods.name: Sarketh Command Core
goods.lore: The commander's core: the order of battle of every Sarketh landing force in the system. The Institute is waiting for it.
goods.use: Brought out of Meridian Fall: what the operation was for.

goods.name: Gatekeeper's Seal
goods.lore: The seal of the Galleria's gate, struck in their gold. Whoever holds it holds the way north.
goods.source: The Gatekeeper, at the Galleria's service gate

goods.name: Levy Captain's Cord
goods.lore: Red thread and gold, cut from a Levy Captain's belt. Every Sarketh in the street knew who wore it.

goods.name: Senior Speaker's Lens
goods.lore: The lens a Speaker reads the beam's orders through. It still flickers with half a message.

goods.name: Lead Runner's Brand
goods.lore: The brass plate a pack of Runners follows. Take it and the pack scatters.

goods.name: Veteran Hunter's Tally
goods.lore: A string of notched crystal beads, one for every hunt. Not one of them was for a Sarketh.

goodsDrops._doc: What a kill and a cache pay in goods beside credits and cores, straight into the inventory: 'kill' for every creature, 'elite' and 'boss' on top of it, 'reliquary' for a cache; and by a creature's own key (its variant, or its boss) what only it carries. Each line: chance, then min..max of the item. -> USOLootTables::GoodsDrops

dismantleGoods._doc: What dismantling a gun gives beside its alloy: its class's material, 'count' of it by rarity, and 'crystal' void crystals by rarity. -> USOLootTables::DismantleGoods / DismantleCount / DismantleCrystal

starterGoods._doc: What a new profile, and one saved before collected items (save version 8), starts with. -> USOLootTables::StarterGoods
